source: MNG iOS Style Guide artifact (https://claude.ai/artifact/V364juyHFU3STfVZ6EgjMc), TroncKit @ e30ad2585, project/tokens.json → type

groups.name: Shared app styles
groups.note: The five fonts every market defines in <Market>+TroncAppThemeable.swift (or <Market>+Font.swift). The closest thing the app has to global Header / Body / Caption styles.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: `headlineNormalFont` (TroncAppThemeable). Spectral-Medium 31 in 75 of 77 markets. Exceptions: OpenSansCondensed-Light 31 (NYDN); OpenSans-Regular 30 (VP).
